rule.description: 在计算 Mamba KV cache group 的 block table 大小时，speculative blocks 应在 max() 比较之后添加，而非之前。否则在长上下文模型中，content blocks 远大于 speculative blocks，导致 speculative blocks 在 max 比较中被丢弃，运行时出现溢出。
checkpoints: speculative blocks 是否在 max() 比较之后添加
block table 大小是否覆盖了 content blocks + speculative blocks
PR 描述是否说明了修复的影响范围

def may_reinitialize_input_batch(self, ...):
        """Reinitialize input batch if necessary.

        This method handles block table sizing for different KV cache specs,
        including Mamba models with speculative decoding support.
        """
        ...
        for kv_cache_group in kv_cache_groups:
            kv_cache_spec = kv_cache_group.kv_cache_spec
            if isinstance(kv_cache_spec, MambaSpec):
                # Calculate block table size for Mamba KV cache group
                # BUG: speculative blocks added before max() comparison
                # causes them to be silently dropped for long-context models
                mamba_blocks_per_req = (
                    max_num_blocks_per_req
                    if self.cache_config.enable_prefix_caching
                    else 1
                ) + kv_cache_group.kv_cache_spec.num_speculative_blocks
                max_num_blocks_per_req = max(
                    max_num_blocks_per_req, mamba_blocks_per_req
                )
            else:
                max_num_blocks_per_req = cdiv(
                    self.model_config.max_model_len,
                    self.cache_config.block_size,
                )
        ...

def may_reinitialize_input_batch(self, ...):
        """Reinitialize input batch if necessary.

        This method handles block table sizing for different KV cache specs,
        including Mamba models with speculative decoding support.
        Note: This fix only affects MambaSpec + speculative decoding
        situation and is a proper fix since mamba_cache_mode=align is
        our default.
        """
        ...
        for kv_cache_group in kv_cache_groups:
            kv_cache_spec = kv_cache_group.kv_cache_spec
            if isinstance(kv_cache_spec, MambaSpec):
                # Calculate block table size for Mamba KV cache group
                # FIX: speculative blocks added AFTER max() comparison
                # ensures they are always reserved on top of content blocks
                mamba_blocks_per_req = (
                    max_num_blocks_per_req
                    if self.cache_config.enable_prefix_caching
                    else 1
                )
                max_num_blocks_per_req = max(
                    max_num_blocks_per_req, mamba_blocks_per_req
                )
                max_num_blocks_per_req += (
                    kv_cache_group.kv_cache_spec.num_speculative_blocks
                )
            else:
                max_num_blocks_per_req = cdiv(
                    self.model_config.max_model_len,
                    self.cache_config.block_size,
                )
        ...
